headline.purpose: Section headings in the reading guide.

title.purpose: Card, dialog and tour headings (20px in dialogs).

metric.purpose: Coverage percentage in the results card.

reading.purpose: Guide text in a 760px column; 16px on phones.

data.purpose: Every measured value: readout, band segments, pills, table numbers, canvas annotations.

shadows.name: floating-layer
shadows.purpose: Menus, dialogs, toast and tour card only. Dark theme: rgba(0, 0, 0, .5).

shadows.name: tour-spotlight
shadows.purpose: Cut-out around the element a tour step points to.

motion.name: tour-spotlight-move

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Toolbar becomes a row above the plan; menu gets its own row.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Single column; results cards in an auto-fit grid below the plan.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: Sticky stage with toolbar beside the plan; plan fits viewport height.

components.name: Button
components.description: Default action: paper fill, hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: "Barlow", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink, #1B222C); background: var(--sheet, #FBFCFD); border: 1px solid var(--line, #C8CFD8); border-radius: 6px; padding: 7px 11px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: var(--muted, #5A6473); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2F43C4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action in a group.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: "Barlow", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--on-accent, #FFFFFF); background: var(--accent, #2F43C4); border: 1px solid var(--accent, #2F43C4); border-radius: 6px; padding: 7px 11px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2F43C4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field { font-family: "Barlow", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted, #5A6473); } .ds-input { font-family: "Barlow", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: var(--ink, #1B222C); background: var(--sheet, #FBFCFD); border: 1px solid var(--line, #C8CFD8); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 8px; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2F43C4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tool Column
components.description: Vertical toolbar glued to the plan; active tool gets paper fill and ink border.
components.css: .ds-tools { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 128px; } .ds-tool { font-family: "Barlow", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink, #1B222C); background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; padding: 7px 11px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tool:hover { border-color: var(--line, #C8CFD8); } .ds-tool[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--sheet, #FBFCFD); border-color: var(--ink, #1B222C); font-weight: 600; } .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2F43C4); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tool kbd { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; margin-left: auto; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted, #5A6473); border: 1px solid var(--line, #C8CFD8); border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 4px; }

components.name: Band Selector
components.description: Segmented control for 2.4 / 5 / 6 GHz; selected segment inverts to ink.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--line, #C8CFD8); border-radius: 7px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--sheet, #FBFCFD); } .ds-seg button { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink, #1B222C); background: transparent; border: 0; padding: 6px 14px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button + button { border-left: 1px solid var(--line, #C8CFD8); } .ds-seg button[aria-checked="true"] { background: var(--ink, #1B222C); color: var(--sheet, #FBFCFD); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2F43C4); outline-offset: 2px; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.css: .ds-card { font-family: "Barlow", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; background: var(--panel, #F3F5F8); color: var(--ink, #1B222C); border: 1px solid var(--line, #C8CFD8); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; max-width: 320px; } .ds-card h2 { font-family: "Barlow Semi Condensed", "Arial Narrow", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; margin: 0; } .ds-big { font-family: "Barlow Semi Condensed", "Arial Narrow", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 40px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-big small { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted, #5A6473); margin-left: 6px; } .ds-bar { display: flex; height: 10px; border-radius: 5px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--grid, #E1E6EC); } .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 12px 1fr auto; gap: 8px; align-items: center; font-size: 13.5px; } .ds-row i { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-row b { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-weight: 400; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
The floor plan is the protagonist. Everything a visitor needs to decide where the router goes happens on one sheet of plan paper: walls drawn in the colors of their materials, nodes as solid ink dots, and the Wi-Fi heat map laid over the drawing like a living layer that changes as soon as a wall or a node moves. The interface around the sheet stays neutral, cool and quiet, so the plan is always the most colorful and most important thing on screen.

The system is technical and precise, but never intimidating. Measurements are exact and set in a monospaced face, categories carry plain-language names next to every dBm value, and the controls look like ordinary, familiar buttons and fields with thin hairline borders. A layperson finishes the job without feeling they opened engineering software; an expert finds every number where they expect it.

Density is moderate: a tool on one side, readings on the other, the plan in the middle and a long reading guide below. Both light and dark themes are first-class and share the same structure.
keyCharacteristics: The plan sheet holds the only saturated color on screen: signal colors and wall materials.
Cool, slightly blue neutrals; one ink accent, Drafting Blue.
Condensed display type for headings and numbers, humanist sans for reading, monospace for measurements.
Thin 1px hairlines and gently rounded corners; flat surfaces, shadows only on floating layers.
Every color that carries meaning is repeated in text.

rules.name: The Plan Leads Rule
rules.body: Saturated color lives on the plan sheet. Interface chrome stays in neutrals plus Drafting Blue; if a control is more colorful than the heat map, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Signal Is Sacred Rule
rules.body: The five signal colors mean signal quality and nothing else. Never use them for buttons, badges or decoration, and never show one without its category name or dBm value next to it.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Drafting Blue marks the main node, the primary action, links and focus. Nothing decorative is blue.

rules.name: The Numbers In Mono Rule
rules.body: Every measured value (dBm, meters, coordinates, percentages in tables) is set in IBM Plex Mono with tabular figures, so numbers line up and read as measurements.

rules.name: The Condensed Is For Headings Rule
rules.body: Barlow Semi Condensed is for headings, labels and big numbers. Paragraphs are always Barlow.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Nothing that sits in the page flow casts a shadow. If an element needs to stand out, change its tone or border, not its elevation.

dos: **Do** keep all saturated color on the plan sheet; the chrome stays neutral plus Drafting Blue.
**Do** pair every signal color with its category name or dBm value.
**Do** set every measurement in IBM Plex Mono with tabular figures.
**Do** use 1px Hairline borders and tonal steps (desk, paper, panel) to separate areas.
**Do** keep the shadow for floating layers only: menus, dialogs, toast and the tour card.
**Do** give every interactive element the 2px Drafting Blue focus outline.
**Do** keep the plan and its toolbar visible together while the results scroll on wide screens.
donts: **Don't** use the signal colors (green, yellow, orange, red) for buttons, badges or decoration.
**Don't** add shadows to cards or anything in the page flow.
**Don't** set paragraphs in Barlow Semi Condensed.
**Don't** load fonts or any other resource from a third-party host; fonts are self-hosted.
